verdict.rationale: Copilot's cloud agent works on tasks autonomously in the background inside isolated cloud sandboxes, and the work comes back for review and merge, so the build-for-review part of the story is documented. The evidence never says the agent runs tests or produces a demo (screenshots, preview deployment or recording) of the feature. missing for 10: documented automated test execution by the cloud agent, demo/preview artifacts for review, independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end delivery.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review

citations.quote: With Copilot cloud agent, GitHub Copilot can work independently in the background to complete tasks, just like a human developer.
let them plan, explore, and execute work autonomously in the background.
Cloud and local sandboxes provide isolated execution environments that let Copilot safely interact with code, tools, filesystem, and network resources
Launch work from GitHub, track progress across multiple agents, review changes, and merge completed work
